title: Independent reading: Matthew 5:1–12
subtitle: Read repeated blessing forms and their attached descriptions.
overview: The Beatitudes repeat a recognizable blessing pattern and vary the descriptions and promised outcomes. Let repetition make the paragraph easier to map.
Read each μακάριοι declaration as a unit, then identify the participial or adjectival description and the ὅτι clause.

items.grc: μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
items.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

items.grc: μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.
items.en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
